origin.details: Missingness for a survival response, one flag per row.
origin.value: True when the row contains a missing time or status.

translation.description: Missingness for a survival response, one flag per row.
translation.details: Missingness for a survival response, one flag per row.
translation.value: True when the row contains a missing time or status.
translation.example:
from survival import Surv, is_na_Surv

def one():
    flags = is_na_Surv(Surv([1, float("nan"), 3], [1, 1, 0]))
    return ["1" if flag else "0" for flag in flags]

print("\n".join(one()))
